title: Acceptance from a satisfying quadratic assignment
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $z$ assign an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each of its $1+n+g$ variables, where $g$ is the number of gates. If $z$ satisfies the circuit’s homogeneous quadratic system, then the circuit accepts the input obtained by decoding the input variables of $z$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment to the circuit’s $1+n+g$ variables
The assignment satisfies the circuit’s homogeneous quadratic system
